item.description: The spectacular Inverted House in Okrokana, on the hillside of Tbilisi, offers a thoughtful rethink of suburban living in a place where fences matter more than views. item.title: BITPLAY AQUASEAL WATERPROOF CUBE SET
item.description: The Bitplay AquaSeal Waterproof Cube Set is one of those small upgrades that quietly makes travel and outdoor days easier. Designed as a true waterproof organizer, this two piece system includes a 500 ml pouch and a larger 1500 ml pouch that nests neatly inside it. From our point of view, that simple detail already sets it apart for anyone who likes clean and efficient packing. Both cubes are built from tough 420D nylon with a TPU coating and airtight zippers, earning an IPX8 waterproof rating.
